skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, role, characteristics, and benefits of pricing management.
Grasp the process of price management, setting prices, and managing prices.
Understand the analysis of costs, market demand, and competition in pricing.
Understand various strategic approaches to pricing by businesses.
Understand techniques for adjusting and changing prices.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Legal and Ethical Issues in Pricing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand legal and ethical issues related to pricing and price management.
Recognize real-world pricing problems and solve practical pricing situations.
Analyze factors influencing price formation at a business and assess their impact on pricing decisions.
Apply knowledge to select strategic pricing options for businesses.
Practice collecting data on factors influencing product pricing at a business.
Practice setting strategic pricing options, pricing plans, and coordinating pricing with other marketing mix elements.
Practice adjusting prices within the framework of established strategic pricing.
Practice analyzing and evaluating pricing scenarios for products at a business.
Practice developing strategic pricing plans, determining prices, and adjusting prices for products.
Practice writing and presenting reports on pricing strategies for products.
